variants.specifics: Brackenford: Brother Anselm begs the player to bring back his novice Pip from the Urchins' barrow.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Please, kind stranger, you must help! The Urchins have dug into the old barrow east of the ford and my poor novice, Pip, went in after them and never came out!

Bring him back and I'll pray for you every day of my life!

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: Whatever you find down in that barrow is yours to keep! Only hurry and bring Pip home!

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: All right! I'll stay close behind you! Only get me out of this hole!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: Quick! Take me back to Brother Anselm!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
Thank goodness, you found him! How will I ever thank you for your courage?!

What's that you say? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well, if that's your price, then please accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Save Pip the Novice from the Urchin barrow east of the ford.

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Lissel's brother Tobb was carried off with the night shift by Grummox's Ogres into the Copper Deep.

plea.speaker: Lissel
plea.text:
Sir! Please help me! A band of filthy Ogres just broke into the Copper Deep, under the town, and dragged off nearly all the night shift! My little brother, Tobb, was with them!

Please bring him back and you'll have a reward, I swear it!

reminder.speaker: Lissel
reminder.text: Oh, what are you waiting for? Tobb is in terrible danger!

found.speaker: Tobb
found.text:
Hail, brave Adventurer! We're just honest miners, carried off from Ostrum when the Ogres broke through!

Can you lead us back up to the town? Do that, and there's a fine reward waiting for you, I'm sure of it, because Ostrum can't dig an ounce of ore without us!

following.speaker: Tobb
following.text: Quickly, kind sir and lead us up out of this pit!

completion.speaker: Lissel
completion.text: Tobb's home! Thank you, thank you, kind stranger! Please accept these as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Rescue Lissel's brother from the Ogres in the Copper Deep.

variants.specifics: Vell: Ulmar begs the player to free Dagny and the boatmen of Vell from the Trolls in the Sunken Keep.

plea.speaker: Ulmar
plea.text: Quickly, lad! The boatmen haven't got long. You've got to free every last one of them before the Trolls cook them!

reminder.speaker: Ulmar
reminder.text: There's no time to lose. Get moving!

completion.speaker: Ulmar
completion.text:
Good work, lad! Every one of these brave boatmen owes you his life!

Take these potions with you. Now go and find the rest of them!

journal.text: Rescue Dagny and the boatmen of Vell held captive in the Sunken Keep.

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Grimwald, the Baron's wizard; his apprentice went down into the Spider nest in the cellars below the keep and has not come back.

plea.speaker: Grimwald
plea.text:
Crawling little horrors! The Spiders just crept up into the keep and have made a real nuisance of themselves!

I am Grimwald, wizard to Baron Hadrim. My apprentice has gone missing. I'm afraid he wandered into the Spider nest in the cellars below us.

Bring him back to me safe, and I will see you properly rewarded. Come along, I'll show you the stair down to that wretched nest.

reminder.speaker: Grimwald
reminder.text: Any word of my apprentice? Oh my, I fear for the boy.

found.speaker: Apprentice
found.text: Thank you for finding me, but I've hurt my leg. The Spiders... they weren't the only things down here! I saw an Og... Og... Ogre! Please, help me back to Master Grimwald.

following.speaker: Apprentice
following.text: Hurry, please! That Ogre could be anywhere!

completion.speaker: Grimwald
completion.text:
My apprentice! Alive, thank goodness!

Clearly those Spiders were nothing to you. Maybe you'd make a decent apprentice yourself. Hmmm... Yes.

Take this robe, then. When you are ready, go up to the keep and tell Baron Hadrim what you saw down there. We have much to do before Vargoth makes his move.

journal.text: Find out what happened to Grimwald's apprentice.

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Fennick the Harbor Master begs the player to bring back his deckhand Tibbet, carried off by the Urchins to their caves on Gull Isle.

plea.speaker: Fennick
plea.text:
Damn it! Where were you, lad!? The Urchins came across the water and raided our docks, and we'd have lost every boat to them if my deckhand Tibbet hadn't rung the alarm bell at the last moment!

But in all the confusion, the little beasts dragged Tibbet off, and the boats are now the least of my worries! All Tolvin will grieve if Tibbet is lost!

You must go where they took him, east to the Urchin caves on Gull Isle! Bring Tibbet back or I'll never forgive myself!

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: I just know Tibbet's in terrible trouble! Hurry, lad!

found.speaker: Tibbet
found.text: Kind sir! Get me out of here, quick! Black Varrick really is the one behind the Urchin raids, and he has wicked plans for the Orb of Calling. I was grabbed when my lantern went out and I can't undo these ropes by myself. Those Urchins tied them so tight there's no hope of wriggling free.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text:
In better times, the whole of Tolvin would throw a feast for Tibbet's safe return! Well done, lad! But now we must put an end to Black Varrick for good.

Please accept these as a token of our gratitude for your brave deed!

journal.text: Go to the caves on Gull Isle and rescue Tibbet.

variants.specifics: Olvane: Master Wendle's students went down for a lesson in the College cellars, now overrun by giant rats and Ghosts. Ebbo is the first one found.

plea.speaker: Wendle
plea.text:
Where in the world have you been!? We have a terrible problem!

Monstrous rats and wailing Ghosts have overrun the cellars beneath the College. Students have been lost in the noble pursuit of knowledge!

Please, I beg of you! Drive the vermin out, bring my students back up and I shall reward you well.

Take this key. It opens the room where my first student is shut in. He will show you where the rest are.

I also have a cure poison potion which may prove handy.

reminder.speaker: Wendle
reminder.text: Bring my students back to me and you will be well rewarded.

found.speaker: Ebbo
found.text: Thank goodness you found me! Please lead me back to the stairs.

completion.speaker: Wendle
completion.text:
You are a true hero! A thousand thanks.

While you were down in the cellars, saving my students, Haskel came by asking for you. He's waiting at the north gate -- at the foot of the hill road.

Before you go, take this gold as your reward.

journal.text: Kill the monsters in the College cellars. Rescue Master Wendle's students.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Tolvar sends the player after Hobb, the Master Builder, trapped in the Lower Vaults when the lift froze.

plea.speaker: Tolvar
plea.text:
While you were up on the battlements, the old lift froze in its shaft -- trapping Hobb in the Lower Vaults far beneath the fort! Brannoc is worried sick for our Master Builder.

We best get down under the fort and find Hobb.

reminder.speaker: Tolvar
reminder.text: Why are you standing about? We must hurry to the lift shaft! Hobb could be freezing to death!

found.speaker: Hobb
found.text:
Hey, it's you! The one Thrane sent!

There are some awfully big spiders down here. I had to bar myself in while I was patching the vault walls.

Here's the key. Go back around to the barred door.

following.speaker: Hobb
following.text: Thanks again. There ought to be potions in that crate. Come on, stay close! I know an old stair that comes out by the Keep!

completion.speaker: Tolvar
completion.text:
Thank goodness you're both safe! You'd make a fine sentry of Ostkar, lad. Brannoc will be pleased you brought his Master Builder home in one piece.

Here, take this Ankh for your trouble.

journal.text: Rescue Hobb from the Lower Vaults beneath Fort Ostkar.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Master Haggarth's apprentices, Pell among them, are trapped in the Old Smelter by Ember Demons.

plea.speaker: Master Haggarth
plea.text:
How long must we wait for help!? Something terrible has happened!

Ember Demons and fire-spitting fiends from the depths have taken over the Old Smelter. One of my apprentices has already given his life for the honor of our guild!

Please, I implore you! Destroy those demons, free my apprentices and I shall pay you well.

This key will open the door to young Pell's hiding place. He can lead you to the rest.

Take this ankh as well. It should prove quite valuable.

reminder.speaker: Master Haggarth
reminder.text: Bring my boys home safe and you won't be sorry.

found.speaker: Pell
found.text: Thank goodness you've come! Here, take this key. The others are locked up past the next door.

following.speaker: Pell
following.text: Please, take me back to Master Haggarth.

completion.speaker: Master Haggarth
completion.text:
My boys are safe! You are a true hero, kind sir! You have my heartfelt thanks.

While you were in the smelter, Mayor Dunbrak's guard came by looking for you. The Mayor wants to see you at his house -- beside the Great Forge.

But first, please take this gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Clear the Ember Demons from the Old Smelter. Rescue Haggarth's 4 trapped apprentices.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Mayor Duvic's house is overrun by bats and his cook Fenna is trapped in the pantry.

plea.speaker: Duvic
plea.text:
These filthy bats are the bane of my house! My guards tried to swat them, but they keep coming back! You're my last hope! Get past those bats and bring my cook out alive!

Fenna is trapped in the pantry, there, through the kitchen door. Please, be careful.

reminder.speaker: Duvic
reminder.text: I shall not set foot inside till Fenna is safe! Kill the bats! Or drive them off! Hurry, before they get to her!

found.speaker: Fenna
found.text: Is somebody there? Oh, please, get me out of here!

following.speaker: Fenna
following.text: Take me back to Mayor Duvic, please.

completion.speaker: Duvic
completion.text:
Kind sir, my warmest thanks! You are a true friend of Torvel Cross. The gatemen will be told that you may pass the toll gate free of charge from now on.

Take this gold for your trouble. I insist.

journal.text: Rescue Fenna the cook from the bats in Mayor Duvic's house.

variants.specifics: Corvale: Warden Grisholm offers a reward for Tibbet, the miller's boy, carried off by the Ogres to their camp in the Skarrow Hills.

plea.speaker: Warden Grisholm
plea.text:
Greetings, young sir. I take it you have come about the reward.

There's a handsome reward for young Tibbet, the miller's boy -- brought home safe and sound. The Ogres grabbed him from his father's field and have kept him in their camp in the Skarrow Hills for days.

Be careful, you don't want those brutes catching you unawares.

reminder.speaker: Warden Grisholm
reminder.text: No word of the miller's boy yet? His poor father is beside himself.

found.speaker: Tibbet
found.text: Who's that? Please, don't let them eat me!

following.speaker: Tibbet
following.text: Please, take me home to my father!

completion.speaker: Warden Grisholm
completion.text:
Ho, there! The miller told me he heard his boy shouting at the gate, so I came running.

You have single handedly snatched young Tibbet from the Ogres! Very impressive! You have my deepest respect, young sir! Those Ogres have plagued Corvale for weeks! I'll see the boy home from here. His father will sleep better tonight with his son safe under his roof!

And here is your reward, young sir -- 100 in gold!

journal.text: Bring young Tibbet home from the Ogre camp.
